summary: Ticket regarding vpn connection failure under category technical issue. User notes: Every time I try to connect to the office VPN I get an authentication error. My network is working fine. Password works ...
possible_cause: Possible network connectivity or VPN authentication issue.
suggested_resolution:
1. Verify internet connectivity.
2. Re-enter VPN credentials and retry connection.
3. Restart VPN client and device.
4. Escalate to Network Admin if issue persists.
